sloka: अपश्यन् नगरम् श्रीमान् नाना जन समाकुलम् ।स ग्Rहैः अभ्र सम्काशैः पाण्डुरैः उपशोभितम् ॥२-१७-२॥
transliteration: apaśyan nagaram śrīmān nānā jana samākulam ।sa gRhaiḥ abhra samkāśaiḥ pāṇḍuraiḥ upaśobhitam ॥2-17-2॥

translations.english: That Rama, proceeded down the middle of the highway made fragrant with agaru and incense, lined with houses gleaming pale white like clouds.
